records.question: Cory has $20.00 and she wants to buy two packs of candies that cost $49.00 each. How much money does Cory need so she will be able to buy the pack of candies?
records.response:
The cost of two packs of candies is $49.00 x 2 = $98.00.
To be able to buy the pack of candies, Cory needs $98.00 - $20.00 = $78.00.

records.question: Randy just turned 12 and started playing the piano. His friend Sheila told him about the 10,000-hour rule which says, after 10,000 hours of practice, you become an expert or master in your field. If Randy wants to become a piano expert before he is 20, how many hours a day will he need to practice if he practices every day, Monday – Friday, and takes two weeks off for vacation each year?
records.response:
Randy will have 8 years until he is 20.
He has 8 * 5 = 40 weeks to practice.
He has 40 * 7 = 280 days to practice.
He has 280 * 2 = 560 days off.
He has 280 + 560 = 840 days to practice.
He will need to practice 10,000 / 840 = 11.9 hours a day.
#### 11.9
